name: zombie_rider.live_native_impact_one_clear_mcw
description: Native single-rider impact with clear approach, survivable separation, cooldown and fresh reapproach.

steps.label: single_clear_impact_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: one staged hostile rider and full-health player load to clear live map

steps.label: audit_single_clear_impact_time
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove noon footing

steps.label: audit_single_clear_escape_lanes
steps.abort_reason: clear approach/separation lanes were not proven

steps.label: audit_single_clear_rider_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove one hostile named-impact rider

steps.label: operate_single_clear_impact_reapproach
steps.objective: Use only advertised native World actions. Let the rider make a real physical closing step and capture one named impact with no same-turn ordinary bite. Move away legally, allow cooldown to expire, then make a fresh physical closing approach and capture a later named impact opportunity. Preserve native receipts, positions, turns, health, cooldown and same-turn ordering.
proof_targets: fresh closing approach and later named impact opportunity
invariants: no debug attack or target injection
no stationary adjacency credited as closing
no bite-only contact credited as impact
cooldown does not re-arm without a fresh closing step
no same-turn extra strike after impact

evidence_contract.claim: one current native zombie rider produces named physical impact, cooldown and fresh-reapproach outcomes
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native closing and impact receipts are required
